sources.title: Review sources
sources.description: Tell us where your business is listed. One listing per directory.

help.google: A Place ID is Google's code for your business listing. It usually starts with ChIJ. Search for your business in Google's finder and copy the ID it shows.

invalid.google: Enter a valid Google Place ID. It usually starts with ChIJ and is at least 20 characters long.
invalid.trustpilot: Enter the business domain Trustpilot lists, like example.com, without https://.
invalid.tripadvisor: Enter the numeric Tripadvisor location ID, like 23462501. It is the number after the d in the page address.
